result.title: From Suboptimal to Optimal: One-Step Latent Flow Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn effective policies from fixed datasets without environment interaction. Although generative models such as diffusion and flow matching enhance policy expressiveness, they typically start from uninformative Gaussian noise and generate actions through multi-step iteration, leading to high computational costs and failing to effectively leverage suboptimal trajectories in datasets. We propose MeanFlow2Better (MF2B), which reformulates offline RL as generative decision chunk optimization from current performance status to better performance status in a high-level latent decision space. MF2B maps trajectory chunks to high-level latent decision representations through an encoder, placing generation starting points within a structured decision space sculpted by behavioral data. The model learns a shared conditional mean velocity field in this space, constructing two flow mappings: from Gaussian-Induced Decision Sources toward positive behavioral decision regions, and from suboptimal decisions toward high-value decision regions. Both flow mappings complete decision refinement through one-step ODE integration over the unit time interval $Δt=1$, requiring neither multi-step iterative sampling nor backpropagation through time. Furthermore, we propose hierarchical chunk-level advantage to guide the flow direction toward high-return regions, where the high-level decisions cover multiple low-level actions, leading to sequence length compression from $T$ to $K \approx T/H$ and significantly lower computational overhead. On the D4RL Gym-MuJoCo benchmark, MF2B achieves an average score of 90.91, matching or surpassing strong baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MF2B，把离线 RL 重构为高层潜决策空间中的生成式决策块优化：用编码器将轨迹块映射为潜决策表示，学习共享条件平均速度场，构造由高斯源指向行为决策区域、由次优决策指向高价值区域的两条流映射，一步 ODE 即可完成精修，并用分层块级优势引导流向。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM 推理无直接关联，但其「从当前状态到更优状态」的一步潜空间流映射、共享速度场与块级压缩，可能为 latent 推理状态的一步更新与长度、计算成本压缩提供可供核查的方法线索。
